description: This file defines the SiloAddress class, which encapsulates details of silo addresses in Orleans, including creation, parsing, hashing, comparison, and JSON serialization. It also includes a converter class for JSON serialization of SiloAddress instances.

classes.name: SiloAddress
classes.description: Represents a silo's network address and related metadata, with methods for creation, parsing, comparison, hashing, and serialization.

classes.name: SiloAddressConverter
classes.description: JSON converter for serializing and deserializing SiloAddress instances.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Factory method to create a new SiloAddress from an IPEndPoint and generation.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Factory method to create a new SiloAddress from an IPAddress, port, and generation.

methods.name: AllocateNewGeneration
methods.description: Allocates a new unique generation number based on current time.

methods.name: ToParsableString
methods.description: Returns a string representation suitable for parsing back into a SiloAddress.

methods.name: ToUtf8String
methods.description: Returns a UTF8 byte array representing the SiloAddress.

methods.name: FromParsableString
methods.description: Parses a string to create a SiloAddress.

methods.name: FromUtf8String
methods.description: Parses a UTF8 byte span to create a SiloAddress.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the SiloAddress.

methods.name: ToStringWithHashCode
methods.description: Returns a string including the hash code.

methods.name: GetConsistentHashCode
methods.description: Computes a consistent hash code for the address.

methods.name: GetUniformHashCodes
methods.description: Returns multiple hash codes for consistent hashing.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Checks if another SiloAddress matches this one based on address and port, considering zero generation as wildcard.

methods.name: IsSameLogicalSilo
methods.description: Checks if another address refers to the same logical silo.

methods.name: IsSuccessorOf
methods.description: Checks if this address is a successor of another based on generation.

methods.name: IsPredecessorOf
methods.description: Checks if this address is a predecessor of another based on generation.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this address to another for ordering.
